mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kapa_official_price_tmp(c_year, pnu) SELECT DISTINCT c_year, pnu FROM (SELECT YEAR (NOW()) AS c_year, A.pnu FROM ltis_pnu A WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kapa_official_price t1 LEFT JOIN kapa_official_price t2 ON t1.PNU = t2.PNU AND t2.c_year = YEAR(NOW()) WHERE t1.c_year = YEAR(NOW()) - 1 AND t1.pnu = a.pnu AND t2.c_year IS NULL AND t1.use_yn = 'Y' ) UNION ALL SELECT RY.YEAR AS c_year, A.pnu FROM ltis_pnu A CROSS JOIN ( WITH RECURSIVE years AS ( SELECT 2018 AS year UNION ALL SELECT year + 1 FROM years WHERE year < YEAR (NOW()) ) SELECT year FROM years ) RY WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kapa_official_price LPA WHERE LPA.pnu = A.pnu AND LPA.c_year = RY.year )) tmp
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM store.kapa_official_price_tmp WHERE c_year IS NOT NULL
DELETE FROM kapa_standard_price_tmp WHERE c_year IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kapa_standard_price_tmp(c_year, s_reg, standard_seq_no) SELECT DISTINCT c_year, reg, standard_seq_no FROM ( SELECT A.c_year, A.reg, A.standard_seq_no FROM kapa_official_price A WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kapa_standard_price B WHERE B.s_reg = A.reg AND B.seq_no = A.standard_seq_no AND B.c_year = A.c_year ) AND A.reg IS NOT NULL AND A.standard_seq_no IS NOT NULL AND A.c_year IS NOT NULL AND A.use_yn = 'Y' ) tmp

INSERT INTO kapa_official_price (c_year, pnu, use_yn) SELECT kopt.c_year, kopt.pnu, 'N' FROM kapa_official_price_tmp kopt LEFT JOIN kapa_official_price kop ON kop.c_year = kopt.c_year AND kop.pnu = kopt.pnu WHERE kopt.c_year != YEAR(NOW()) AND kop.c_year IS NULL
